title: Contracting for Decision-Relevant Beliefs
abstract: arXiv:2609.23285v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forecasts guide decisions, but an expert who privately values the decision may misreport beliefs to influence it. We study contracts that jointly elicit the expert's belief about a verifiable state and her stake in a binary action. When agents with different stakes can hold the same belief, exact belief-only IC forces the action to ignore the report. Joint screening permits responsiveness but may require implementation rent. For thresholds, minimum implementation rent equals the distribution-weighted positive curvature of the belief-dependent cutoff. Optimal threshold design is rent-adjusted concavification. We give sufficient conditions for unrestricted threshold optimality and, beyond them, bounds and a direct optimality certificate.

translated_title: 面向决策相关信念的合同设计
translated_abstract: 预测能够引导决策，但一个私下关心决策结果的专家可能会虚报其信念以影响决策。我们研究了能够同时引出专家对可验证状态的信念以及其在二元行动中的私人利益的合同。当具有不同利益关系的代理人可能持有相同信念时，仅基于信念的严格激励相容性会迫使行动必须忽略报告。而联合筛选机制允许决策对报告做出响应，但可能需要支付执行租金。对于阈值机制而言，最小执行租金等于信念依赖的临界值所对应的分布加权正曲率。最优阈值设计等价于经过租金调整的凹化。我们给出了阈值机制无约束最优性的充分条件，并在这些条件之外提供了最优性的界以及直接的最优性证明方法。
tldr: 该论文研究了同时引出专家信念与私人利益的合同设计问题，证明了仅基于信念的激励相容会使决策忽略报告，并将最优阈值设计刻画为租金调整的凹化。
en_tdlr: This paper studies contracts that jointly elicit an expert's belief about a verifiable state and her stake in a binary action, showing that exact belief-only IC forces the decision to ignore reports, and characterizes optimal threshold design as rent-adjusted concavification.
